ai.greeting: Hi! How can I help? Ask about products, shipping or returns.
ai.payment: Payment is by card only: Cart → Checkout → Card payment → We send the order summary by email. Never share card details in chat – only on the secure checkout page.
ai.shipping: We dispatch within 24–48 hours after payment. Carriers: Post, GLS, Foxpost, DPD. Free shipping over 25,000 HUF.
ai.returns: Returns: the customer pays return shipping. Refund within 3 days after the item is received and inspected. We do not accept returns for damaged, worn, incomplete or tagless items. EU withdrawal rights apply (except underwear/hygiene).
ai.authenticity: There is no official authenticity certificate. Items are sourced from auctions and discount channels, which allows very good prices. We are transparent with photos and descriptions.
ai.register: Register and get a coupon for your first purchase. We'll email you about future deals and new arrivals.
ai.complaint: Please share your order ID and email, and briefly describe the issue (with a photo if possible). We'll create a ticket and our team will get back to you soon.
ai.handover: I'll pass this to a human agent. Please share your order ID and email, and we'll contact you shortly.
ai.productQuestion: Condition, size and price are on the product page. Shipping in 24–48 hours; free over 25,000 HUF. If you have more questions, just ask.
ai.noCard: Please never share card details, ID or passwords here. Payment is only on our secure checkout page.
ai.recommend: Which category interests you most? (Bags, Clothing, Accessories, Electronics) I can suggest 3–5 products.
ai.thanks: Thanks! If you have more questions, just ask.
ai.default: You can ask about products, shipping (24–48 h, free over 25,000 HUF), returns or payment. How can I help?
ai.title: Gulumen – Help
ai.cta: Got a question? I can help!
ai.escalateNote: ↑ Case forwarded to a human agent.
